description:
The cost estimation subsystem (benchbox/core/cost/) currently supports these
cloud platforms: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, Athena.

Three commercial cloud platforms are missing cost estimation support:
- Firebolt: Consumption-based pricing (compute + storage credits)
- Azure Fabric DW: Capacity Units (CU) based pricing
- Azure Synapse: DWU-based pricing (provisioned) or serverless bytes scanned

Without cost support, benchmark runs on these platforms report total_cost: 0,
which is misleading for users doing cost/performance analysis.

This work complements the Athena cost estimation fix completed on 2024-12-24.
